# Third-party audio (all CC0 / public domain)

Every recorded sound in the game is CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication). No attribution is legally required; credit is given anyway.
Files are processed (trimmed, mono-summed for positional sounds, filtered, loudness-normalised, layered or looped) by `C:/Users/리오/BL23Lab/AudioLab/Forge` (`Recipes.cs`).
Runtime: `Game/Audio/Sfx.cs` plays `Resources/Sfx/<id>_<n>` (manifest `_manifest.txt`) in place of the synthesized recipe; `Game/Audio/AmbienceDirector.cs` plays `Resources/Ambience/<bed>`.

Sources: Kenney (kenney.nl, CC0) · OpenGameArt CC0 packs by rubberduck · BigSoundBank.com by Joseph Sardin, sounds marked "CC0 (public domain): Free and royalty-free" (licence page https://bigsoundbank.com/licenses.html).
Downloaded 2026-09-27 with the owner's permission (safe sites, audio files only). Originals: `C:/Users/리오/BL23Lab/AudioLab/src/` (bsb/*.meta hold each page URL).
